module: Flowgraph node "im Checkbox" (category repeat_instant, tag imgui): imgui checkbox. Inputs: "text", "enabled" (true), pulses "setOn" / "setOff". Outputs: "on", "off", "checked" (bool), "changed" (pulse). The initial state comes from data.startState (false).

_executionStarted.desc: Applies startState and updates the outputs again.

work.desc: Applies setOn/setOff, draws the checkbox (disabled if enabled is false) and updates on/off/checked/changed.
